newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services files secondary share offer.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services files secondary share offer.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said Thursday it filed with the Securiteis and Exchange Commission for the secondary offering of up to 1.5 million common shares.
The shares will be sold by two principal shareholders, W. James Hindman, chairman and founder of the company, and Henry Felton, it said.
It did not specify exactly how much each of the shareholders will sell out of the total offering.
It said, however, that after the offering Hindman will continue to own a stake of 9.4 percent in the company.
Hindman wil resign after the sale but will remain a director and chairman of the executive committee.
The company said its board will appoint Tim Cole, its chief executive officer and president, as board chairman and Hindman as chairman emiritus.
